title: v1_129 / Authentication
content:
## Authentication

### GitHub Enterprise support for Copilot in the agent host

Developers whose GitHub Copilot access is provided through a GitHub Enterprise (GHE) instance can sign in and use Copilot in VS Code. Previously, the agent host's Copilot authentication only supported github.com, so a GHE-backed Copilot subscription could not complete sign-in: both the OAuth flow and the Copilot token request targeted github.com.

With this release, VS Code can authenticate Copilot against a GitHub Enterprise instance. When you sign in to Copilot, choose your GitHub Enterprise instance, and VS Code runs the sign-in flow and requests Copilot access tokens from that host instead of github.com. This works in both the editor window and the [Agents window](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/agents/run/agents-window), and with both the Copilot and Claude agents.

Because this support is part of [the agent host](#the-agent-host), ensure the agent host is enabled with `setting(chat.agentHost.enabled)`.
